meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 Git 专家：会自动拆分多个原子提交、执行 rebase/squash 整理历史、搜索代码修改历史（谁写的、什么时候加的、哪个提交引入的）。
howto.when: 当你说“提交”、“rebase”、“squash”、“谁写了”、“什么时候加的”、“找到引入的提交”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交这3个文件，拆成原子提交。
say.note: Claude 会分析文件并生成多个提交。

say.text: rebase 当前分支到 main，保留我的提交。
say.note: Claude 会执行交互式 rebase。

say.text: 查找添加 login 函数的提交。
say.note: Claude 会用 git log -S 搜索。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a Git expert: it automatically splits changes into atomic commits, performs rebase/squash to clean history, and searches code history (blame, bisect, log -S) to find when/where changes were introduced.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that', or any Git operation request.

say_en.text: Commit these 3 files as atomic commits.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and create multiple commits.

say_en.text: Rebase current branch onto main, keeping my commits.
Find the commit that added the login function.
say_en.note: Claude uses git log -S to search.
